title: #1 Push Pull Legs
author: DSP
desc: Modified off of JN ppl. Less risk to reward exercises, removed deadlift etc added others. Exercises that feel best for me. Test post to community

ex.note: PRESS ALL THE WAY UP TO YOUR TOES, STRETCH YOUR CALVES AT THE TO BOTTOM, DON'T BOUNCE
SIT BACK AND DOWN, 15° TOE FLARE, DRIVE YOUR KNEES OUT LATERALLY   Should be 70% of 1 rep max but I could only write RPE 70. Barbell back squat
BRACE YOUR LATS, CHEST TALL, HIPS HIGH, PULL THE SLACK OUT OF THE BAR PRIOR TO MOVING IT OFF THE GROUND
TUCK YOUR CHIN AND RIB CAGE DOWN, ONLY MOVE YOUR HIPS. USE A PAD
You can twist to get more flute activation
FOCUS ON SQUEEZING YOUR QUADS TO MOVE THE WEIGHT
FOCUS ON SQUEEZING YOUR HAMSTRINGS TO MOVE THE WEIGHT
Do on smith machine
TUCK ELBOWS AT A 45° ANGLE, SQUEEZE YOUR SHOULDER BLADES AND STAY FIRM ON THE BENCH
BRING THE DUMBBELL ALL THE WAY DOWN, KEEP YOUR TORSO UPRIGHT
Squeeze
Low to high START WITH YOUR HANDS OUT TO YOUR SIDES AND PALMS FACING THE CEILING, FOCUS ON PULLING YOUR ELBOWS UP AND IN WHILE ROTATING YOUR PALMS TO FACE THE FLOOR
Line down Tricep
RAISE THE DUMBBELL "OUT" NOT "UP", MIND MUSCLE CONNECTION WITH MIDDLE FIBERS
SQUEEZE YOUR GLUTES AND FOCUS ON KEEPING YOUR LOWER BACK FLAT, CUT THE ROM SHORT IF YOU CAN'T MAINTAIN THIS POSITION
PULL YOUR ELBOWS DOWN AGAINST YOUR SIDES, use the medium width attachment
Cable wide grip lean back on seat
PULL YOUR ELBOWS UP AND OUT, SQUEEZE YOUR SHOULDER BLADES TOGETHER
ARC THE BAR "OUT", NOT "UP". FOCUS ON SQUEEZING YOUR FOREARMS
ARC THE BAR "OUT", NOT "UP". FOCUS ON SQUEEZING YOUR BICEPS
FOCUS ON SQUEEZING YOUR BICEPS TO MOVE THE WEIGHT
Use smith machine or calf machine when possible. Use high weight!
Either lying down on bench with a small kettle bell, with a machine, with a monkey foot thing, or standing against the wall with body weight
Avoid butt wink, be technical, can sub with goblet squat. If there is a belt squat machine, take it and go ham on that.
Using dumbbells for weight
Use kettle bell or dumbell for weight, do each leg 8 reps. Make sure you work with upright back, feel the stretch
High foot placement
SINGLE LEG. Start with weaker leg
SINGLE LEG. Start with weaker leg
SHOULDER WIDTH GRIP, ELBOWS DOWN AT YOUR SIDES
Clear your head out of the way, go slow, imagine doing a handstand push-up
45 deg, mind muscle connection with upper pec
Focus on bringing inner elbows together not your hands. Get a good stretch and flex
Focus on slow using the lateral delt to move the weight
USE FLAT BAR ATTACHMENT, we’re training the muscle up tricep push down movement
Slow control the weight

PULL YOUR ELBOWS DOWN AGAINST YOUR SIDES
, use the closest pulldown attachment
FOCUS ON SQUEEZING YOUR SHOULDER BLADES TOGETHER, PULL WITH YOUR ELBOWS UP AND OUT
FOCUS ON SQUEEZING YOUR SHOULDER BLADES TOGETHER, PULL WITH YOUR ELBOWS DOWN AND IN
LEAN YOUR TORSO AT A 45° ANGLE, FOCUS ON PULLING THE WEIGHT STRAIGHT DOWN, NOT "IN"
Shrug up to your ears, hold for a second at the top
FOCUS ON SWEEPING THE WEIGHT OUT LATERALLY
Can go single arm but prefer to do double arm
Focus on your bicep to move the weight, curl while rotating wrist laterally to hit brachioradialis
